_doc: IVP's cross-investor rulings for COLLECTION.md invariant 10 (run.py verify), scoped to this investor and merged at read time with data/collection/cross-investor.json. Written in the PRO-92 run, 2026-09-26. `distinct` = the loose name key matched two different companies (IVP's historical book shares many names with later startups); `accepted` = the same company, where the sibling's published row is the stale or disputed side and a session may not touch another investor's directory mid-wave (COLLECTION.md 12), so each is raised for the wave alignment.
